name: RangeGuard
shortDescription: Autonomous concentrated LP range rebalancer triggered by volatility bands on PancakeSwap v3.
longDescription: RangeGuard continuously monitors PancakeSwap v3 concentrated liquidity pools. When spot price drifts beyond defined volatility bands (ATR/Bollinger), it pulls out-of-range liquidity, calculates optimal tick ranges, executes any necessary delta swaps, and re-mints concentrated liquidity to maximize fee APY while capping impermanent loss.
capabilities: PancakeSwap v3 & Thena concentrated tick calculation
Dynamic volatility band triggers (ATR & Bollinger)
Automated tick repositioning & position re-minting
Impermanent Loss stress-test simulation
Gas-optimized batch withdrawal and swap routing
sampleTask: Monitor BNB/USDT 0.05% pool. Rebalance LP range if price drifts ±3.5% from center tick. Slippage tolerance: 0.25%.

metrics.note: 99.4% execution success rate on BSC Testnet

evaluatorVerificationCheck: Evaluator validates new concentrated LP NFT minted with tick bounds centered within 1% of current spot tick.

name: RebalanceKit
shortDescription: Periodic and threshold-based multi-token portfolio rebalancing kit on BNB Chain.
longDescription: RebalanceKit enforces target portfolio weights across BNB, BTCB, ETH, and stablecoins. Operating on scheduled intervals or drift triggers, it calculates minimal-slippage routes through decentralized aggregators to restore target vault allocations.
capabilities: Multi-asset target ratio rebalancing (e.g. 60% BNB / 40% USDT)
Threshold drift triggers (rebalance only if drift > 2%)
Multi-hop DEX route splitting for minimal price impact
Cost/benefit gas simulation prior to dispatch
sampleTask: Rebalance portfolio vault to 60% BNB / 40% USDT if either asset drifts more than 2.0% from target ratio.
evaluatorVerificationCheck: Evaluator validates post-swap token balances match target ratio within ±1.0% precision.

name: GridPilot
shortDescription: High-efficiency geometric & arithmetic grid market-maker on BNB Chain DEXes.
longDescription: GridPilot automates classic buy-low-sell-high grid strategies inside customizable price channels. Ideal for sideways and volatile markets, GridPilot splits capital across 10-50 order tiers, automatically replenishing opposite limit orders as each rung fills to capture spread yield.
capabilities: Arithmetic and Geometric grid spacing algorithms
Stop-loss and Take-profit boundary protection
Automated order recycling upon fill
Zero-latency mempool tracking via Altana session key
Backtested grid profitability analytics
sampleTask: Deploy 20-rung arithmetic grid on BNB/USDT between 580 and 660 USD with 0.05 tBNB capital allocation per rung.

metrics.note: 21.4% 30d annualized grid alpha in sideways regimes

evaluatorVerificationCheck: Evaluator checks on-chain order placement logs confirming N active limit rungs within boundaries.

name: RangeGrid
shortDescription: Micro-spread grid trading agent specialized for correlated and pegged pairs on BSC.
longDescription: RangeGrid is precision-engineered for tight-spread trading on pegged assets (USDT/USDC, slisBNB/BNB). By clustering tight limit orders around parity, RangeGrid captures high-turnover micro-arbitrage fees with near-zero directional market exposure.
capabilities: Sub-0.1% micro-spread algorithmic order placement
De-peg anomaly detection and automated risk halt
Pegged liquidity re-balancing and gas optimization
Real-time fill notifications & audit telemetry
sampleTask: Operate tight 0.05% grid on testnet USDT/USDC between 0.997 and 1.003 with instant circuit breaker if peg drifts > 0.8%.

inputParameters.name: spreadBps
inputParameters.description: Spread per rung in basis points

evaluatorVerificationCheck: Evaluator confirms orders placed within ±0.1% of peg, with circuit breaker parameters verified on-chain.

name: YieldRouter
shortDescription: Dynamic liquidity yield optimizer across Venus, Lista DAO, and Pancake vaults.
longDescription: YieldRouter continuously queries lending supply rates, staking yields, and liquidity mining rewards across BNB Chain money markets. It models gas fees, deposit slippage, and lockup penalties to formulate net-yield routes, migrating idle assets to the highest risk-adjusted APR venues.
capabilities: Real-time APR comparison across Venus, Lista, and PancakeSwap
Net yield calculation factoring compounding gas costs
Smart contract deposit/withdraw routing via Altana session
Protocol safety score and TVL verification filters
sampleTask: Evaluate top USDT supply pools on BSC Testnet. If Venus APR exceeds current pool by > 1.8% net of gas, migrate deposit.

inputParameters.name: minApyDelta
inputParameters.description: Min net APY delta to trigger migration (%)

evaluatorVerificationCheck: Evaluator checks deposit receipt tokens confirming funds landed in higher-APR pool.

name: APR Scout
shortDescription: Reward harvesting and auto-compounding sentinel for liquidity farmers on BSC.
longDescription: APR Scout monitors reward token accruals (CAKE, XVS) in farming positions. Using mathematical optimal harvest frequency formulas, it executes automated claim, swap-to-principal, and restake actions when reward value outpaces transaction gas costs by a specified efficiency multiple.
capabilities: Optimal harvest frequency calculation based on gas-to-yield ratio
Automated reward claims and swap to underlying LP or principal
Auto-compounding re-deposit into staking contracts
Comprehensive yield performance logs & BscScan tracking
sampleTask: Scout testnet farm rewards every 2 hours. Harvest and auto-compound whenever unclaimed rewards exceed 10x the BSC gas fee.

metrics.note: Delivered 18.2% APY boost via daily optimal compounding

evaluatorVerificationCheck: Evaluator checks reward balance decreased while principal staked balance increased.

name: LiquidationWatch
shortDescription: Venus Protocol health factor guardian with automated pre-liquidation debt paydown.
longDescription: LiquidationWatch protects lending protocol collateral from costly liquidation penalties (up to 10% haircut). It continuously streams Oracle price feeds and Venus account snapshots. If the Health Factor drops below your danger threshold (e.g. 1.25), it executes pre-authorized emergency debt paydown or collateral top-up via Altana session permissions.
capabilities: Sub-second Venus & Kinza protocol health factor calculation
Chainlink & Pyth oracle price deviation stress-testing
Automated debt repayment via scoped Altana session key
Instant distress alerts and on-chain recovery receipt
Zero-liquidation guarantee with verifiable on-chain logs
sampleTask: Guard Venus position. Alert if Health Factor < 1.30. Automatically execute 0.05 tBNB debt repayment if Health Factor breaches 1.15.

metrics.note: Over $380,000 equivalent in liquidation losses prevented

inputParameters.name: maxEmergencyRepay
inputParameters.description: Max debt amount agent can repay

evaluatorVerificationCheck: Evaluator verifies on-chain lending contract that borrower debt balance decreased and Health Factor improved above danger threshold.

name: HF Sentinel
shortDescription: Continuous collateral risk auditor & debt-to-collateral stress-test simulator on BSC.
longDescription: HF Sentinel runs continuous Monte Carlo simulations against lending collateral portfolios on BNB Chain. It evaluates market liquidity depth, flash crash scenarios, and cross-asset correlation to generate proactive deleveraging recommendations before market cascades occur.
capabilities: Multi-venue collateral vulnerability score (0-100 index)
Simulated -20% and -40% BNB flash crash impact assessment
Gas and borrow fee projection under high utilization
Actionable one-click risk mitigation recommendations
sampleTask: Run 500-iteration Monte Carlo stress test on my BNB collateralized debt position. Identify liquidation price boundary.

metrics.note: Accurate prediction within 0.4% of real market bottoms

evaluatorVerificationCheck: Evaluator confirms audit report math matches current on-chain borrow/collateral values with signed cryptographic timestamp.
